title: Answer: humans, animals, and in principle machines with rich sensorimotor mastery

statements.text: Any creature, or machine, that masters sensorimotor contingencies and uses that mastery in thought and action is perceptually conscious. A robot embodied so that its encounters have bodiliness and grabbiness would have at least primitive visual experience, while a simple ping-pong robot would not.

sources.quote: For a creature (or a machine for that matter) to possess visual awareness
it becomes necessary to say that it has (at least primitive) visual experiences
